title: gleichenia borneensis
intro: Gleichenia borneensis, commonly known as the Bornean forked fern, is a species of fern in the family Gleicheniaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asia for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Gleichenia borneensis are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and bioactive constituents of this plant.
